With text="aaaaa", key="aa" and value="aaa", method1 replaces the first "aa" (positions 0–1) with "aaa", then the next non‑overlap at positions 2–3 with another "aaa", and finally appends the remaining single "a", yielding "aaaaaaa" (7 a’s). Method2, however, updates the buffer after each replacement and advances the search index by the length of the inserted value. After the first replacement the buffer becomes "aaaaaa"; the next search starts after the inserted "aaa" (index 3), so the second occurrence of "aa" (originally at positions 2–3) is not found again. Thus method2 returns "aaaaaa" (6 a’s). The two methods therefore produce different return values for this input.
